log: BIOLOGICAL CONTEXT FOR ORPHAN CATALYSTS -- does WHERE and WHICH WAY beat chemistry alone?
Two of the proposed filters are ALREADY ENFORCED and add nothing: the candidate vocabulary is
human catalysts from Reactome + HumanGEM, and the metabolite universe is the same two human
sources. There are no non-human proteins or foreign molecules in the network to remove.
The two real levers are COMPARTMENT (never used) and DIRECTION (in/out currently pooled).
PREDECLARED: compartment beats chem at every k AND beats a SHUFFLED compartment map => location
is informative. compartment ~ shuffled => the gain is re-ordering, not biology.

LOCATION ADDS NOTHING. compartment 0.545 vs chem 0.552 at k=20.
Chemistry already implies location -- reactions sharing metabolites tend to share a
compartment, so the filter is redundant with the neighbours it is filtering.
